design.thresholds: Nearest-rank BF16 positive magnitude CDF over six calibration sources, inclusive abs(h)<=t; development sources never select thresholds
design.controls: Per-row exact equal-k nested random and calibration h^2 times W2-column-L2 ranking
design.estimand: Mean valid-row gate-relative SSE within each source/site, then equal sites, then equal development source
design.arithmetic: CPU FP32 dropped_h @ W2.T, multiplied by stored native gate; reference stored native BF16 Y times gate; b2 cancels algebraically
design.full_depth_scope: All160 original BF16 teacher-state local sites, not free student trajectory
design.physical_saving: No sparse kernel executed; no W1 or W2 deployed saving established

decision: Magnitude thresholds beat both exact-count controls at the measured local source/site cases; now test fixed thresholds on full160 normal student free videos before judging motion, quality or deployment.
